name: Delicious Snowball Blooms Atop Snowfields
desc: A classic layered salad. The snowball flowers lining the rim seem to bloom at the very end of a winter wasteland, and the rich, golden yolk serves as a setting sun painting the horizon with its light. You remain entirely lost in this delightful culinary artwork, until your spoon taps the bottom of an empty plate. Wait... when did I finish the whole thing?

value.text: Increases all party members' ATK by 228 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
